"'''Return to Dagobah'''" is a short story published in ''[[The Original Trilogy Stories]]''. It was written by [[Meredith Rusu]].<ref name="Original" /> It adapts the events of [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi]] from [[Luke Skywalker]]'s departure from [[Tatooine]] to arrival at the planning of the [[Battle of Endor]].
